verdict.rationale: Lium's official CLI offers `lium spend`, which reports burn per hour and spend per pod. That gives a per-workload usage breakdown from the terminal. There is no documented billing or usage API endpoint, export, or team/tag attribution. Per-key USD budgets are spending limits rather than spend reporting, and volume cost history is a UI click-through, so neither counts here. Missing for 10: a documented API endpoint for usage and billing breakdowns, attribution by team/project/tag or by API key, an exportable billing report, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can pull usage and billing breakdowns programmatically to attribute GPU spend by team or workload

citations.quote: lium spend                                     # burn per hour, spend per pod, runway
